top_choice_rationale: P001 most clearly recognizes a bounded physical invention and its defining experimental realization: magic-wavelength confinement enabled interrogating atomic ensembles without the limiting trapping shift. Its long experimental maturity supports a genuine new measurement capability, while Katori and Ye provide the most defensible compact attribution if the citation remains confined to optical lattice clocks rather than later performance advances.
recusal_note: No conflict is apparent from the supplied profile; I have no identified collaboration, institutional connection, or other relevant relationship with the proposed laureates.
